# Lead CRM

A comprehensive Lead CRM application designed for automated business discovery, contact extraction, and outreach tracking.

## Core Capabilities
- **Business Discovery**: Search Google Places by keyword, location, and radius.
- **Lead Enrichment**: Fetch full business profiles, websites, and reviews.
- **Outreach CRM**: Track lead status and interaction history (Contacted, Qualified, etc.).

## Key Entry Points
- [AI_AGENT.md](AI_AGENT.md): Full API specification and agent-native tool definitions.
- [/api/search](src/app/api/search/route.ts): Search endpoint.
- [/api/place-details](src/app/api/place-details/route.ts): Enrichment endpoint.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS.
- Persistence: IndexedDB (Client-side lead management).
- APIs: Google Places API (Server-side proxy).
